title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 388 (Provisions as to expert's consent and allotment)

content.overview: No person shall issue, circulate or distribute in India any prospectus offering for subscription in securities of a company incorporated or to be incorporated outside India, whether or not it has established or will establish a place of business in India, unless the expert-consent and allotment conditions that the section applies from the domestic prospectus regime are complied with. Expert statements require written consent that has not been withdrawn; allotment conditions track the applicable Indian public-offer rules as applied by the section.
content.glance: Foreign-company prospectus in India must satisfy expert-consent and allotment conditions as applied by s. 388.
content.study: Section 388 extends expert-consent and allotment safeguards to prospectuses for securities of companies incorporated or to be incorporated outside India when issued in India. An expert’s statement may not appear without written consent that remains unwithdrawn. Allotment conditions follow the domestic rules as the section applies them. The section applies whether or not the company has a place of business in India.
